triples.tail_surface: check the drive rotation to see that it matches the pump rotation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查驱动旋转方向是否与泵旋转方向一致
triples.evidence_text: At initial startup, before bolting coupling halves together, check the drive rotation to see that it matches the pump rotation.

triples.tail_surface: Check the shaft alignment as covered in Installation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按安装章节要求检查轴对中
triples.evidence_text: Prior to each startup, check the shaft alignment as covered in Installation.

triples.tail_surface: Check the bearing and stuffing box for proper lubrication
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查轴承和填料函润滑是否适当
triples.evidence_text: Check the bearing and stuffing box for proper lubrication and install oil in pumps with oil lubricated bearings.

triples.tail_surface: Check to see that V-ring seals (if supplied) are properly seated against bearing covers
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查V型密封圈是否正确贴合轴承盖
triples.evidence_text: Check to see that V-ring seals (if supplied) are properly seated against bearing covers.

triples.tail_surface: install oil in pumps with oil lubricated bearings
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 为油润滑轴承泵加注润滑油
triples.evidence_text: Check the bearing and stuffing box for proper lubrication and install oil in pumps with oil lubricated bearings.

triples.head_surface: Operation of the pump without proper lubrication
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泵在无适当润滑下运行
triples.tail_surface: damage to the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵损坏
triples.evidence_text: Operation of the pump without proper lubrication will cause damage to the pump and possible personal injury.

triples.tail_surface: Check that the shaft turns freely by hand
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 手动检查泵轴转动是否灵活
triples.evidence_text: Check that the shaft turns freely by hand.

triples.tail_surface: Check that the shaft guard is in place
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查轴防护罩是否就位
triples.evidence_text: Check that the shaft guard is in place.

triples.tail_surface: Check the bearing lubricant
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查轴承润滑剂
triples.evidence_text: Check the bearing lubricant.

triples.tail_surface: Any valve in the suction line must be completely open
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 吸入管路阀门必须完全打开
triples.evidence_text: WARNING! Any valve in the suction line must be completely open.

triples.tail_surface: Prime the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 对泵进行灌引水
triples.evidence_text: Prime the pump in one of the following ways:

triples.tail_surface: open the vent valve on top of the pump casing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 打开泵壳顶部排气阀
triples.evidence_text: If the pump operates under positive pressure, open the vent valve on top of the pump casing.

triples.tail_surface: After all entrained air has escaped, close the vent valve
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 待所有夹带空气排尽后关闭排气阀
triples.evidence_text: After all entrained air has escaped, close the vent valve.

triples.head_surface: air trapped in the impeller passages
triples.tail_surface: Rotate the shaft, if possible, to allow any air trapped in the impeller passages to escape
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 如可能则盘车以排出叶轮流道内滞留空气
triples.evidence_text: Rotate the shaft, if possible, to allow any air trapped in the impeller passages to escape.

triples.tail_surface: Trapped air should be allowed to escape through the vent valve while filing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 充液时通过排气阀排出滞留空气
triples.evidence_text: Trapped air should be allowed to escape through the vent valve while filing.

triples.head_surface: air from the pump case and the suction line
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泵壳及吸入管路中的空气
triples.tail_surface: use a vacuum pump or ejector operated by air, steam, water, etc., to evacuate air from the pump case and the suction line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用真空泵或喷射器抽除泵壳及吸入管路中的空气
triples.evidence_text: use a vacuum pump or ejector operated by air, steam, water, etc., to evacuate air from the pump case and the suction line by connecting the ejector to the priming connection on top of the pump case.

triples.head_surface: stuffing box seal line and water lubrication line
triples.head_canonical_zh: 填料函密封水管和润滑水管
triples.tail_surface: Open valves in the stuffing box seal line and water lubrication line near the stuffing box
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 打开填料函附近密封水管和润滑水管阀门
triples.evidence_text: Open valves in the stuffing box seal line and water lubrication line near the stuffing box, if fitted.

triples.tail_surface: Open discharge valve slowly when the pump is up to speed
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵达到转速后缓慢打开排出阀
triples.evidence_text: Open discharge valve slowly when the pump is up to speed.

triples.head_surface: operated against a closed valve for more than a few minutes
triples.head_canonical_zh: 在关闭阀门状态下运行超过数分钟
triples.tail_surface: Overheating
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 过热
triples.evidence_text: Overheating and/or loss of prime will result if the pump is operated against a closed valve for more than a few minutes.

triples.head_surface: operated against a closed valve for more than a few minutes
triples.head_canonical_zh: 在关闭阀门状态下运行超过数分钟
triples.tail_surface: loss of prime
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 失去引水
triples.evidence_text: Overheating and/or loss of prime will result if the pump is operated against a closed valve for more than a few minutes.
